neighbours.label: nouns naming a conflict or dispute between parties (conflict, dispute, clash, friction)
fire: The two neighbours finally settled their long conflict over the fence.
Mediators were sent to calm the border dispute between the provinces.
Workers and managers had a bitter dispute about overtime pay.
Diplomats hoped to end the armed conflict before winter arrived.
There was constant friction between the coach and the star player.
The lawsuit grew out of a contract dispute with the supplier.
Teachers learn to resolve conflicts among children on the playground.
A violent clash between rival fans broke out after the match.
quiet: The two neighbours finally built a new fence together last spring.
Mediators were sent to the provinces to help with the harvest.
Workers and managers had a friendly meeting about overtime pay.
Diplomats hoped to sign the trade agreement before winter arrived.
There was a warm friendship between the coach and the star player.
The lawsuit was filed on behalf of the supplier last week.
Teachers learn to organise games for children on the playground.
A cheerful parade of rival fans marched through town after the match.

notes: Card: top tokens ' conflict(s)', ' disputes', 争端, احتكاكات; logit effect suppresses conflict/disputes/escal.
